items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited.
items.why: Left practice early; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Monitor Friday report; Adams already out 6-10 weeks elevates Nacua target ceiling if he plays, or opens for secondary WRs/TEs if sits.
items.opportunity: With Adams out, Nacua projected heavy targets; calf risk now.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley is expected to return to practice today and is in line to play Monday against the Cowboys.
items.why: Sources say expected return to practice and play vs DAL.
items.implication: Major upgrade for PHI offense; reverse prior handcuff/backup boosts.
items.opportunity: RB1 usage vs favorable DAL matchup.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Availability for Week 7 vs SEA highly uncertain; elevates other KC pass-catchers.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (limited, quad).
items.opportunity: Lead back if active vs MIA.

items.text: The Seahawks have activated RB Zach Charbonnet from the PUP list, a significant move. Also Arroyo season-ending shoulder surgery.
items.why: Activated from PUP; Arroyo out for season.
items.implication: Adds competition/depth in SEA backfield; impacts Walker/others.

items.text: Josh Jacobs was allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad; OL mess contributes. Discussed long-term outlook on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive; backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Jacobs ROS outlook solid if cleared; fade poor backups short-term.
items.opportunity: Lead back role expected on return.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on workload question.

items.text: Notable: Terrance Ferguson (eligible off IR) not expected ready soon, recovery will take time. Was biggest Adams injury beneficiary. Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.implication: Massive target spike for Nacua ROS/weekly if healthy.
items.conflict: New calf injury now risks availability.

items.text: Chiefs placed OT Josh Simmons on injured reserve.
items.implication: OL hit for KC; protection concerns with Rice also out.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10) and DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Bears good for yardage; Smith elite volume.
items.why: Matchup + usage; Bears yardage, Smith volume.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12). Big workloads in friendly matchups. Saquon in line to play (RB15) efficient prior.
items.why: Workloads + defenses carved by RBs; Saquon efficiency + DAL matchup.
items.implication: Start these RBs; Saquon upgrade if active.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) on workload question after layoff; Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37) brutal spot. Also hates Rome Odunze, Josh Downs, Travis Kelce.
items.why: Jacobs layoff/workload; Skattebo matchup; Odunze/Kelce tough D; Downs target share low.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive Jacobs ROS via facility/backups poor.

items.text: Loves Jordan Love @ DET (QB3) and Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6). Packers-Lions high-scoring; Lions D gift to pass catchers. Also loves Matthew Golden deep targets.
items.why: Shootout potential; Lions allow high completion deep; Kraft usage.

items.text: Week 7 Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB @ CAR. Slow-paced slogs MIA @ NYJ. Other notes GB/DET/LAR/LV high volume potential.
items.why: TB/CAR tempo up; MIA/NYJ low snaps/scoring; GB-DET high combined snaps/points.
items.implication: Prefer high-pace games for fantasy volume; avoid slogs.
items.opportunity: Elevated play volume TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.

items.text: Giants plan to start J.J. McCarthy vs Houston. Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9, McCarthy 5.7. Different scheme/coaches/small sample but tough to ignore.
items.implication: Concern for Jefferson efficiency/volume with McCarthy starting.
